plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Coding mode (DietrichGebert/ponytail 5.3.3, MIT, offline copy): reuse what exists, write the smallest correct change, never cut validation, security or tests; /ponytail-review and /ponytail-audit. Measured here: about 18% faster, 19% fewer output tokens, 35% less code. For coding, not storage chats.
